metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace for verification-first development tools and privacy-first professional context building.

plugins.name: devenv
plugins.description: Set up, repair, upgrade, and optimize your whole dev environment — Homebrew, runtimes (mise), dotfiles (chezmoi), zsh↔fish, Ghostty, Neovim, git, ssh, macOS defaults — with a shared settings store and cross-skill bootstrap/health runbooks. Ships a Stop hook that reminds you when chezmoi-managed dotfiles drift, and a PreToolUse guard that mechanically blocks reading secret-by-location files (private keys, .netrc, .aws/credentials) into the model's context.

plugins.name: digital-twin
plugins.description: Build, use, and maintain a consenting person's private professional digital twin through governed document review, interviews, approved snapshots, grounded career assistance, feedback, and owner-controlled updates.
